transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I'm just... tired, I guess. I keep thinking it would be better if I didn't wake up. Like, maybe dying would be... a fair punishment. For what I've done to my family. And my crew.
Do you believe you truly deserve to die because of what you’ve done?

...Yeah. I mean... my husband got worse because of me. And the crew... they lost work. I messed up clients' homes. 

It's just like... I don't know. Like I poison everything I touch. So... yeah. I deserve whatever happens to me.
Do you believe, with complete certainty, that you have actually caused your husband’s worsening and your crew’s losses, even when other people tell you that isn’t true?

I just... I know what I know. Even when I'm not feeling this low, or stuck in bed... I just know it. 

People say I'm wrong, but... they don't see it. The homeowners, the suppliers... they use the floor patterns. And the texts they send. The permit calls. They're tracking me. To see if I'm ruining the jobs on purpose. And... nobody can talk me out of it. Because I know it's happening.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually high, energized, or wired for days at a time?
...No. I don't... I don't think so. I don't get like that.
Have these beliefs that people are tracking you ever been present when you were not depressed?

...Yeah. I guess so. There was a stretch of a few weeks where... I was doing a little better. Getting up, eating... not crying all day. 

But... it didn't really change things. I was still convinced the clients and the suppliers were tracking me. And... I still heard the voice while I was at work. So... yeah. It didn't stop.
Before this current episode, have you ever had another period like this where you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
...No. I don't... I don't think so. I mean, everyone has bad days, but... I don't remember it ever being like this before. Not for weeks.
Was there ever a period of at least two weeks when you were still hearing the voice or felt tracked, but you were not depressed?

...Yeah, I think I just said that. There was a time... a few weeks, maybe. I was getting up, eating a bit more. Not crying. But... the voice was still there at work. And I still knew they were tracking me. It didn't go away.
